BJP MPs' visit to 1984 riots convict's home sparks political row

Three Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) Members of Parliament visited the residence of Sajjan Kumar, a convict in the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, to offer condolences following his death. The visit has triggered a political controversy. Sources indicate the BJP has sought explanations from the three MPs involved.
